module.purpose: Defines shared TypeScript contracts for enterprise workflow scheduling, booking context, form submissions, workflow administration, and call-detail state.
module.summary: This file centralizes type aliases used across workflow execution, configuration, persistence, form routing, booking notifications, and Retell call interfaces. It models workflow definitions and steps, booking and attendee data, mutually exclusive execution contexts, database-enriched workflow listings, form values, and call-detail UI state. The declarations connect Prisma records with application-specific permissions, calendar responses, routing-form responses, and telephony data.
module.businessContext: Supports scheduling automation that reacts to bookings and routed form submissions, including reminders and communications. Failures can cause invalid workflow configuration, incorrect attendee notifications, or unusable call-management interfaces.
classes: Workflow (~L17-26): Represents a configured automation with trigger timing ownership and ordered steps
WorkflowStep (~L28-40): Represents one executable workflow action and its notification configuration
FormSubmissionData (~L42-50): Represents routed form responses alongside submitting user localization details
AttendeeInBookingInfo (~L52-60): Represents attendee identity contact localization and language information
BookingInfo (~L62-92): Represents booking details used by workflow actions and event communications
WorkflowContextData (~L94-99): Represents mutually exclusive booking or form-submission workflow execution context
ScheduleEmailReminderAction (~L101-104): Restricts reminder actions to supported email recipient destinations
WorkflowListType (~L106-131): Extends persisted workflows with teams activation targets and permissions
FormValues (~L133-145): Represents workflow configuration values submitted through administrative forms
CallData (~L147-147): Represents either Retell web-call or phone-call response data
CallDetailsPayload (~L149-152): Represents modal visibility and optionally selected call information
CallDetailsState (~L154-156): Represents client state for the call-details interface
CallDetailsAction (~L158-165): Represents opening or closing actions for the call-details interface
systemCapabilities: Manage team and event workflow activation

contractsProvided.name: Workflow
contractsProvided.shape: type Workflow = { id: number; name: string; trigger: WorkflowTriggerEvents; time: number | null; timeUnit: TimeUnit | null; userId: number | null; teamId: number | null; steps: WorkflowStep[]; }

contractsProvided.name: WorkflowStep
contractsProvided.shape: type WorkflowStep = { action: WorkflowActions; sendTo: string | null; template: WorkflowTemplates; reminderBody: string | null; emailSubject: string | null; id: number; sender: string | null; includeCalendarEvent: boolean; numberVerificationPending: boolean; numberRequired: boolean | null; verifiedAt?: Date | null; }

contractsProvided.name: FormSubmissionData
contractsProvided.shape: type FormSubmissionData = { responses: FORM_SUBMITTED_WEBHOOK_RESPONSES; routedEventTypeId: number | null; user: { email: string; timeFormat: number | null; locale: string; }; }

contractsProvided.name: AttendeeInBookingInfo
contractsProvided.shape: type AttendeeInBookingInfo = { name: string; firstName?: string; lastName?: string; email: string; phoneNumber?: string | null; timeZone: string; language: { locale: string }; }

contractsProvided.name: BookingInfo
contractsProvided.shape: type BookingInfo = { uid?: string | null; bookerUrl: string; attendees: AttendeeInBookingInfo[]; organizer: { language: { locale: string }; name: string; email: string; timeZone: string; timeFormat?: TimeFormat; username?: string; }; eventType?: { slug: string; recurringEvent?: RecurringEvent | null; customReplyToEmail?: string | null; }; startTime: string; endTime: string; title: string; location?: string | null; additionalNotes?: string | null; responses?: CalEventResponses | null; metadata?: Prisma.JsonValue; cancellationReason?: string | null; rescheduleReason?: string | null; hideOrganizerEmail?: boolean; videoCallData?: { url?: string; }; }

contractsProvided.name: WorkflowContextData
contractsProvided.shape: type WorkflowContextData = { evt: BookingInfo; formData?: never } | { evt?: never; formData: FormSubmissionData; }

contractsProvided.name: WorkflowListType
contractsProvided.shape: type WorkflowListType = PrismaWorkflow & { team: { id: number; name: string; members: Membership[]; slug: string | null; logo?: string | null; } | null; steps: WorkflowStep[]; activeOnTeams?: { team: { id: number; name?: string | null; }; }[]; activeOn?: { eventType: { id: number; title: string; parentId: number | null; }; }[]; readOnly?: boolean; permissions?: WorkflowPermissions; isOrg?: boolean; }

contractsProvided.name: FormValues
contractsProvided.shape: type FormValues = { name: string; activeOn: Option[]; steps: (PrismaWorkflowStep & { senderName: string | null; agentId?: string | null; inboundAgentId?: string | null; })[]; trigger: WorkflowTriggerEvents; time?: number; timeUnit?: TimeUnit; selectAll: boolean; }

contractsProvided.name: CallDetailsPayload
contractsProvided.shape: type CallDetailsPayload = { showModal: boolean; selectedCall?: CallData; }

contractsProvided.name: CallDetailsAction
contractsProvided.shape: type CallDetailsAction = { type: "OPEN_CALL_DETAILS"; payload: CallDetailsPayload; } | { type: "CLOSE_MODAL"; }
